newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar retains firmness, volume solid.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar retains firmness, volume solid.

text.p: White sugar futures held on to their earlier firmness on Friday as a mixed pack of buyers jumped on the morning's rally and kept the March contract bubbling above $300, traders said.
Earlier in the session a combination of commission house and trade buying fuelled March through $300 and up to an intraday high of $302.00.
"There was quite a lot of aggressive buying this morning...most of it is genuine volume," said one trader. "There'll probably be some resistance to it."

Other traders said Indonesia's recent purchases of lesser-quality Thai whites were likely to be the physical background to the firmness, although steady buying has also been noted from Pakistan and Iran.
At 1720 GMT March was up $2,90 at $301.00 and May up $2.70 at $299.60. All other traded positions gained ground.
Overall volume reached a hefty 3,302 lots but only around 400 of these were reported as against actuals trades.
Traders said with the raws market devoid of fundamental news, New York was for once dependent on London for sentiment.
"If it's all whites-orientated and the raws producers take no notice and continue to sell the market on a scale-up basis, then there's every chance the premium will increase," said one trader.
"And if it does start to increase significantly I would imagine there may be be one or two people getting a bit jittery in the short term," he said.
Trading in Paris was confined to the two nearby positions. Volume was solid at 1,722 lots.
March was up $2.30 at $301.00 and May up $2.60 at $299.80.
